description: Membership Module 1: real models with business logic in model/service methods, the DRF mobile read API (DefaultRouter + /me semantics), minimal staff web views, and the web portal shell (build-time Tailwind/daisyUI, one django-component, one HTMX partial, inline Lucide SVG). Depends on FEAT-001 (settings, custom User, RBAC helpers/adapters, django-components wiring).
steps: Create apps/membership (apps.py AppConfig name='apps.membership' label='membership'; register in INSTALLED_APPS) with models.py: MemberProfile (OneToOneField(User); membership_status TextChoices ACTIVE/EXPIRED/PENDING; date_joined; nullable expiry_date; methods is_active_on(date) and mark_expired()); Enrollment (ForeignKey(MemberProfile); start_date; end_date; created_by ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL); created_at; method activate() setting the member's status/expiry); Attendance (ForeignKey(MemberProfile); check_in_at DateTimeField; check_in_date DateField; recorded_by ForeignKey(AUTH_USER_MODEL); Meta UniqueConstraint on (member, check_in_date)). Override Attendance.save() to set self.check_in_date = timezone.localdate(self.check_in_at or timezone.now()) before super().save() so the uniqueness invariant holds for EVERY caller.

Create apps/membership/services.py: enroll_member(...) requiring end_date > start_date (raise django.core.exceptions.ValidationError on failure; wrap in transaction.atomic() so no DB write happens on failure); record_attendance(member, check_in_at=None) computing the_date = timezone.localdate(check_in_at or timezone.now()), inserting inside transaction.atomic(), and on IntegrityError re-querying by (member, check_in_date=the_date) (NOT by check_in_at) and returning the existing row idempotently. Business logic lives here and in model methods, never in views/serializers.
Create apps/membership/admin.py and the fresh initial migration (python manage.py makemigrations membership).

Create the DRF mobile read API in api/ (api/ is a plain module, NOT an installed app): api/serializers.py with read-only serializers for MemberProfile and Attendance; api/views.py with MemberProfileViewSet (ReadOnlyModelViewSet) exposing @action(detail=False, methods=['get'], url_path='me') -> GET /api/membership/me/ returning the caller's own MemberProfile as a single object, or 404 {'detail': 'No member profile.'} when absent, and MyAttendanceViewSet (ReadOnlyModelViewSet) -> GET /api/attendance/ whose get_queryset() filters strictly to the caller's own profile (profile-less user -> 200 []), guarded by the CanViewAttendance DRF permission so another member's data is unreadable; api/urls.py with a DefaultRouter registering 'membership' (basename='membership') and 'attendance' (basename='attendance').
Wire the API into profit/urls.py with path('api/', include('api.urls')).

Create minimal staff web views in apps/membership/views.py: a member-list view guarded by role_required(can_manage_enrollment) and a member-detail view guarded by role_required(can_view_attendance), plus an HTMX search view returning the partial templates/membership/_member_rows.html. Add apps/membership/urls.py and include it in profit/urls.py.

Build the web portal shell: static/src/ with package.json, tailwind.config.js, and input.css (@tailwind base/components/utilities + the daisyUI plugin) compiling to static/dist/app.css; templates/base.html linking the compiled stylesheet via {% static %} ONLY (no CDN) and loading vendored HTMX and Alpine from static/vendor/; components/button/ (button.py + button.html using daisyUI btn classes); components/icon/ (icon.py + icon.html) that inlines a vendored static/vendor/lucide/<name>.svg via {% component "icon" name="..." %}. Add a small vendored Lucide SVG subset under static/vendor/lucide/ and vendored static/vendor/htmx.min.js and static/vendor/alpine.min.js. The member-list template (templates/membership/member_list.html) and member-detail template (templates/membership/member_detail.html) must use the button and icon components to prove the pattern.

Confirm the django-components==0.100 wiring against that exact version so the example component actually renders (adjust only the loader path / COMPONENTS dir if the 0.100 API shape differs — do NOT change the pin).
acceptance_criteria: `python manage.py makemigrations membership` produces one migration and `python manage.py migrate` applies it on SQLite.
`python manage.py check` exits 0 and the example django-component renders to non-empty output in a template (a wrong django-components==0.100 loader path fails this).

A DRF APIClient test shows GET /api/membership/me/ returns 404 {'detail': 'No member profile.'} for a profile-less user, GET /api/attendance/ returns 200 [] for the same user, and a member cannot read another member's attendance.
record_attendance is idempotent: a second call the same Manila day returns the original row, and enroll_member raises ValidationError (with no DB write) when end_date <= start_date.
verification: Run `python manage.py makemigrations membership` then `python manage.py migrate` and confirm success.
Run `python manage.py check` and confirm it exits 0 with the component rendering.
Run `python manage.py test apps.membership` (service idempotency/validation + DRF access tests) and confirm all pass.
Append the real command output to .agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/verification.md.
findings: FEAT-002 verified on Python 3.13.14 offline (SQLite default): makemigrations membership -> single membership.0001_initial (MemberProfile, Enrollment, Attendance + unique_member_check_in_date on (member, check_in_date)); migrate=0; check=0 with the example django-component rendering non-empty ('<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary ">Save</button>') and a wrong django-components loader path failing the gate (membership.E001); test apps.membership = 8 tests OK. Hand-offs for later FEATs: (1) django-components==0.100 real API shape confirmed: components are classes subclassing django_components.Component decorated with @register('name'); they use template_name (relative to the component dir), get_context_data(self, **kwargs), and templates load with {% load component_tags %} + {% component 'name' ... %}{% endcomponent %}. AUTODISCOVER stays False (the .venv under BASE_DIR makes a blanket tree-walk risky); components are registered via COMPONENTS['libraries'] = ['components.button.button','components.icon.icon'] because django_components calls import_libraries() at startup REGARDLESS of autodiscover. Any new component must (a) live under components/<name>/ with an __init__.py and (b) be added to COMPONENTS['libraries']. components/ and each component dir carry __init__.py so the library import path resolves. (2) The icon component inlines a vendored static/vendor/lucide/<name>.svg at render time via {% component 'icon' name='user' %}; add new icons as SVG files there (names restricted to [a-z0-9-]; unknown/invalid names render empty, never raise). Vendored icons shipped: user, users, search, calendar-check, menu. (3) HTMX (static/vendor/htmx.min.js, v1.9.12) and Alpine (static/vendor/alpine.min.js, v3.14.1) are vendored and linked in templates/base.html via {% static %} only (no CDN); base.html also links the build-time stylesheet static/dist/app.css (compiled by static/src Tailwind+daisyUI; npm build is a DEPLOY artifact, not needed for check/test). (4) MemberProfile exposes .user (OneToOneField) and .user_id, so apps.accounts RBAC helpers' member.user_id lookups work; attendance ownership is enforced two ways in api/views.py MyAttendanceViewSet: get_queryset filters member__user=request.user (list -> 200 [] for profile-less, strict self-scope) and CanViewAttendance guards object reads via has_object_permission. IMPORTANT: CanViewAttendance is NOT applied as a blanket has_permission on the list action (the pure helper correctly returns False for a Member with no target, which would wrongly 403 a member listing their OWN records); the list uses IsAuthenticated + queryset scoping. A later FEAT reusing CanViewAttendance on a collection must apply the same pattern or it will block members. (5) services.enroll_member(member,start,end,created_by) is atomic and raises django.core.exceptions.ValidationError (no DB write) when end<=start; services.record_attendance(member,check_in_at=None,recorded_by=None) is idempotent per Manila day (IntegrityError recovery re-queries by (member, check_in_date=the_date), NOT by check_in_at). Attendance.save() materializes check_in_date=timezone.localdate(check_in_at or now()) for every caller. (6) api/ remains a plain module (no __init__.py added; include('api.urls') works via namespace package, matching how FEAT-001's api.index imported). DefaultRouter registers 'membership'(basename=membership) and 'attendance'(basename=attendance); wired at profit/urls.py path('api/', include('api.urls')). Staff web at path('membership/', include('apps.membership.urls')) with member_list/member_search(HTMX partial _member_rows.html)/member_detail, gated by role_required(can_manage_enrollment)/can_view_attendance. (7) FEAT-003/004 (billing/finance) still owe their apps + the PayMongo webhook; nothing in FEAT-002 touched them.
